subject: Redeployment request & hiring-pause carve-out for infra coverage
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Talentsoup Recruiting <talent@talentsoup.co>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redeployment request & hiring-pause carve-out for infra coverage

Hi Marcus + Monica —

Quick context: after the staging rollout last week we observed a sustained latency regression tied to the attention optimization subsystem. The infra team has traced the highest-severity incidents to a KV cache mismatch that requires focused engineering time to implement a coordination patch and validate across quantized variants.

Current state: the engineer who owns the optimization work (IC: A. Kumar) is on an approved internal rotation to Product Analytics until end of Q3. Given the timing of the customer migration (Acme Health scheduled for late Sept) and the performance risk, I’m requesting a 6-week redeployment of one senior ML engineer from my team to Infra to lead the fix and regression tests.

Request summary (what I need from you):
- Marcus: short approval for a hiring-pause carve-out so we can redeploy and still open a backfill request that bypasses the hiring freeze for up to 90 days (budget code OPS-2026-Q3).
- Monica: HR sign-off on the redeployment paperwork and confirmation we can extend rotation/compensation guardrails for the engineer who will fill the analytics role temporarily.

I’ve attached: org-chart.pdf (current reporting), proposed-MAP.xlsx (target tasks + rollout timeline), salary-band.csv for compensation check. Linked a Confluence entry with the risk assessment: https://confluence.redwood.ai/HC/REQ-4821

Why this is time-sensitive: Acme Health is a top-20 customer for Dedicated capacity and we have a contractual latency SLO in the enrollment path. If we don’t remediate before their migration, we risk escalation + credits.

Mitigations and exit criteria:
- Redeployed engineer will be dedicated to the fix for 6 weeks; weekly check-ins (Mon) and a regression benchmark before handback.
- If fix is not production-ready by week 5, we’ll escalate to Marcus for a decision on an additional contractor.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through the MAP.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Manager, ML Systems
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: org-chart.pdf (3 pages), proposed-MAP.xlsx (tab: timeline, owners, tests), salary-band.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Talentsoup Recruiting <talent@talentsoup.co>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 20:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redeployment request & hiring-pause carve-out for infra coverage

Camila —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the MAP. I agree this is higher-risk than we initially estimated given Acme Health’s migration timeline. I’m provisionally approving the 6-week redeployment and the hiring-pause carve-out under the following conditions:

1) We keep the scope limited to the KV cache coordination and perf regression items in the MAP. No broad architectural rewrites.
2) You commit to 1x weekly status updates in the leadership #ops-standup channel and attach the benchmark results after each sprint.
3) Monica confirms the HR checklist and we document the temporary role change (incl. reporting lines) in Workday prior to redeployment.

Budget: OPS-2026-Q3 is acceptable; finance should receive the MAP and a one-line approval note. I’ll escalate to Finance if anything beyond the 90-day carve-out is requested.

Please proceed with HR steps and schedule the redeployment for Aug 9 so we can start testing the change by week 1.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redeployment request & hiring-pause carve-out for infra coverage

Hi Camila / Marcus —

HR can support the temporary redeployment and the limited hiring carve-out. A few administrative items we need before formalizing: 

- Confirm the employee name who will be redeployed (provide start date Aug 9 and expected end date Sep 20).
- Sign-off on the role duration and reporting change in Workday; I’ll send the temporary assignment form.
- Confirm there are no PII/data access changes needed for the redeployed engineer; if they need additional infra access we must raise a ticket to InfoSec (takes ~3 business days).
- For the hiring carve-out, please confirm the justification and the recruiting plan for a backfill that we can advertise internally first (60% internal mobility target). We’ll need a short posting and approval form for the exception.

I’ve attached a template for the temporary assignment and a checklist. Once we have the signed form and a short justification paragraph, I’ll route to People Ops leadership and Finance for the carve-out note.

Monica Patel
Head of People Operations (People Ops)
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: hr-temp-assignment-template.docx, carve-out-checklist.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Talentsoup Recruiting <talent@talentsoup.co>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redeployment request & hiring-pause carve-out for infra coverage

Thanks —

Confirmed redeployed engineer: Priya Natarajan (Sr. ML Engineer). Start: Aug 9. End (tentative): Sep 20. No PII changes required; she already has production infra access but I’ll open the InfoSec ticket for logging scope.

Justification paragraph for carve-out (for People Ops / Finance):
"Short-term redeployment to mitigate imminent SLA risk for a named top customer (Acme Health). The work is narrowly scoped, time-bound (6 weeks), and aligned to existing team expertise. Approving this carve-out minimizes customer downtime risk and avoids larger contract remediation costs. Backfill will be posted internally first; external recruiting will only proceed if internal mobility yields no suitable candidate within 21 days."

I’ve uploaded the signed temporary-assignment form to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP and attached the MAP.

Next steps: Monica — if you can route the exception with the above, I’ll coordinate with Talentsoup to prepare an internal-first job posting and keep weekly updates in the #ops-standup channel.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Camila Reyes
Sr. Manager, ML Systems
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: signed-temp-assignment.pdf, proposed-MAP.xlsx (final)
